content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lakewood

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Verify your education and documented work history meet these thresholds before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend all sessions synchronously from anywhere, engage directly with active certified practitioners, and cover the full PMBOK® Guide framework required by PMI.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing bootcamp coursework, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with proof of education and project experience. Pay PMI's exam fee at that time. Allow time for PMI to review and approve your eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and instructor guidance to master the PMP content. Schedule your exam when ready, then take the computer-based test at an authorized Pearson VUE center near Lakewood.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning the PMP, maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) across PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your competitive advantage in your local job market.
